paragraphs.text: Modern alpinists try to climb mountains by a route which will give them good sport, and the more difficult it is, the more highly it is regarded.

inlineAnnotations.label: alpinists
inlineAnnotations.description: 因为登山运动起源于 alpine ，所以去“e + ist

paragraphs.text: In the pioneering days, however, this was not the case at all.
The early climbers were looking for the easiest way to the top, because the summit was the prize they sought, especially if it had never been attained before.

inlineAnnotations.label: the easiest way to the top
inlineAnnotations.description: 最容易的，去往上顶的路

inlineAnnotations.label: because
inlineAnnotations.description: 引导 原因状语从句

expansionNotes.label: modern 现代的

examples.enExample: I had little acquaintance with modern poetry.
The rubbish in modern landfills does not rot.
examples.zhExample: 现代垃圾填埋场里的垃圾不会腐烂。

examples.enExample: The gallery houses 2 000 works of modern art.
examples.zhExample: 美术馆收藏了2 000件现代艺术作品。

examples.enExample: Modern fertilizers should be used judiciously.
examples.zhExample: 现代化肥应被明智地使用。

expansionNotes.label: sport n. [U] fun; amusement 乐趣

examples.enExample: Swimming in the sea gives you good sport.
He tormented the cat only for sport.
They rescued humans out of curiosity or for sport.
…which will give them good sport, … ↔…which will give them good / a lot of fun, …

expansionNotes.label: The 比较级 ... , the 比较级 ... 比较级句型 (越…越…) 两个the 分别放在句首，前从句(先翻译)，后主句

examples.enExample: The younger the child is, the more is the child's need of sleep.
examples.zhExample: 主句中的【主语太长】可以用【倒装】

examples.enExample: The younger the child, the more the child's need of sleep.
examples.zhExample: 如果谓语是be动词，且主语不是代词，则be动词【可省略】（可省一个留一个）

examples.enExample: The stronger the magnet is, the greater is the number of lines of magnetic force.
examples.zhExample: 主句主语长用倒装（避免头重脚轻）

examples.enExample: The higher the standard of living is, the greater is the amount of paper used.
I play (the) better, the more I practice.
examples.zhExample: 【变化形式】前半句放句中，后半句放句首（后从前主）The more I practice, the better l' play.

examples.enExample: They became (the) hungrier , the harder they worked.【变化形式】后半句是从句(从后往前翻译)
... of becoming more likely to die the older we get, was something self-evident, like the cooling of a hot kettle or the wearing-out of a pair of shoes.
... because the dust becomes thinner the further we travel towards the outer edges of our own solar system.
Needless to say, the bigger the risk an insurance company takes is, the higher will be the premium you will have to pay.
The harder you work, the greater progress you will make.
examples.zhExample: 你越努力，就会取得越大的进步。

examples.enExample: The more he gets, the more he wants.
examples.zhExample: 他得到越多，想要的也越多。

examples.enExample: The more democracy spreads, the stronger become the forces of peace.
The greater the percentage of such customers is, the weaker is the argument’s evidence as an indication of customer satisfaction with the change.

expansionNotes.label: case 真实的情况（实情）

examples.enExample: No one suspected that there might be someone else on the farm who had never been seen. This was indeed the case.
This is not the case at all.
This is not always the case.
This is indeed the case.
This might not be the case.
This is not necessarily the case.

expansionNotes.label: the early climbers 早期的登山者

examples.enExample: Pioneers of technology changed the world with their inventions.

examples.word: predecessors
examples.enExample: We built on the work of our predecessors.
The pioneer climbers opened new routes to the summit.

expansionNotes.label: prize 荣誉；目标; 奖赏 （暗喻）sense of pride / honor / accomplishment 自豪感、荣誉感、成就感

examples.enExample: The summit was the prize they longed for.
Victory was a prize worth any risk.
He worked hard to win the prize of promotion.

expansionNotes.label: seek v. try to achieve sth. 寻求；寻找；探索；搜索

examples.enExample: seek refuge / asylum
seek compensation
seek advice
The incumbent president will not seek reelection.
Virgo woman seeks Scorpio man.
She sought advice from her mentor.
He sought compensation for the damage.
They sought a safer path to the peak.

paragraphs.text: It is true that during their explorations they often faced difficulties and dangers of the most perilous nature, equipped in a manner which would make a modern climber shudder at the thought, but they did not go out of their way to court such excitement.

inlineAnnotations.label: during their explorations
inlineAnnotations.description: 时间状语“在他们的探索过程中”

inlineAnnotations.label: of the most perilous nature
inlineAnnotations.description: 做前面“difficulties and dangers”的后置定语：最危险的类型（nature 种类）

inlineAnnotations.label: out of their way to
inlineAnnotations.description: 不怕麻烦的特意做某事

paragraphs.text: They had a single aim, a solitary goal -- the top!

inlineAnnotations.label: 同义词连用(重要的事情说三遍)

expansionNotes.label: * It is true that ..., but ... 诚然…但…(让步、转折经常用于议论文)

examples.enExample: It was true that he had just bought a lamb, but his lamb was black.
It is true that they faced danger, but they didn’t seek it.
examples.zhExample: 诚然他们面对危险，但他们并非刻意追求。

examples.enExample: It is true that she is young, but she is very competent.
examples.zhExample: 诚然她很年轻，但她非常能干。

examples.enExample: Admittedly, I could have tried harder, but I still don't think all this criticism is fair.
examples.zhExample: 诚然我本可以更努力，但我仍觉得这些批评不公平。

examples.word: Granted, ..., but ...
examples.enExample: Granted, he doesn't look too bad for his age, but I don't fancy him.
examples.zhExample: 诚然他这个年纪看上去还不错，但我不喜欢他。

examples.enExample: that is not to say that ...

expansionNotes.label: be faced / confronted with 面临着、面对着...

examples.enExample: China is faced / confronted with the problem of overpopulation.
examples.zhExample: 中国正面临人口过剩的问题。

examples.enExample: They were faced / confronted with a serious economic crisis.
examples.zhExample: 他们面临着严重的经济危机。

examples.enExample: Animals confronted with uncontrollable situations may behave passively later.
examples.zhExample: 动物在无法控制的情况下可能会表现出消极的行为。

expansionNotes.label: of ... nature 某种类型的… 做后置定语，修饰前面的名词

examples.enExample: I can’t approve of things of this nature.
treaties of a political nature
books of an erotic nature
questions of an academic nature
articles of a technical nature
dangers of the most perilous nature

expansionNotes.label: be equipped with 装备上

examples.enExample: The soldiers were equipped with night vision goggles.
This car is equipped with the latest safety system.
examples.zhExample: 这辆车配备了最新的安全系统。

examples.enExample: The city was even equipped with a drainage system.
Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.

expansionNotes.label: in a manner 以…方式(a manner单数)

examples.enExample: He spoke in a manner that impressed everyone.
examples.zhExample: 他说话的方式让所有人印象深刻。

examples.enExample: She behaved in a manner not suitable for the occasion.
examples.zhExample: 她的行为方式不适合这个场合。

examples.enExample: The machine works in a manner that saves energy.
examples.zhExample: 这台机器的工作方式很节能。

expansionNotes.label: at the … of … 【时间状语短语】一…就...

examples.enExample: She screamed at the sight of the ghost.
She trembled at the thought of the murder.
She woke at the sound of the bell.
She fainted at the news of her father’s death.
She wept at the mention of the accident.
He laughed at the thought of his childhood antics.
examples.zhExample: 一想到小时候的恶作剧他就笑了。

examples.enExample: ... your stomach would turn at the idea of frying potatoes in animal fat...
... they always go into raptures at the mere mention of the country.

expansionNotes.label: go out of one's way (to do ...) 不怕麻烦地 / 特意做…

examples.enExample: Please don't go out of your way for me.
It was very kind of you to go out of your way to meet us at the airport.
He went out of his way to help the new employee.
examples.zhExample: 他特意去帮助那位新员工。

examples.enExample: They went out of their way to welcome us.
examples.zhExample: 他们不辞辛劳地欢迎我们。

expansionNotes.label: a single aim, a solitary goal 唯一的目标（同义词连用，用于加强语气）

examples.enExample: She had a single aim, a solitary goal -- to win the championship.
examples.zhExample: 她只有一个目标——赢得冠军。

examples.enExample: He lived his life with a single aim, a solitary goal — to find the truth.
examples.zhExample: 他一生的目标就是寻找真理。

examples.enExample: The explorers pushed forward with a single aim, a solitary goal — the summit.
examples.zhExample: 探险者们只有一个目标——登顶。

expansionNotes.label: 词语重复以加强语气 强调情感或语气

examples.enExample: 虚情假意、山盟海誓、千刀万剐、深仇大恨
I'm sick and tired of your excuses / silliness.
She always complains of her aches and pains.
He never wants to pick and choose.

paragraphs.text: It is hard for us to realize nowadays how difficult it was for the pioneers.
Except for one or two places such as Zermatt and Chamonix, which had rapidly become popular, Alpine villages tended to be impoverished settlements cut off from civilization by the high mountains.

inlineAnnotations.label: Except for
inlineAnnotations.description: 除了...（介词短语做状语） Except 不能单独用于句首。

inlineAnnotations.label: which
inlineAnnotations.description: 引导非限定性定语从句，用于修饰“Zermatt and Chamonix”

paragraphs.text: Such inns as there were were generally dirty and flea-ridden; the food was simply local cheese accompanied by bread often 12 months old, all washed down with coarse wine.

inlineAnnotations.label: as
inlineAnnotations.description: 《新概念》第一次出现 as 引导限定性定语从句（先词前需要有呼应词）

inlineAnnotations.label: generally
inlineAnnotations.description: Such inns as there were tended to be dirty and flea-ridden;
小句号，后面的句子【可以】不需要加连词。

inlineAnnotations.label: often 12 months old
inlineAnnotations.description: 后置定语，常常为12个月之久的(面包)

inlineAnnotations.label: 并列句，省掉了谓语动词be（was）

paragraphs.text: Often a valley boasted no inn at all, and climbers found shelter wherever they could --sometimes with the local priest (who was usually as poor as his parishioners), sometimes with shepherds or cheese-makers.
Invariably the background was the same: dirt and poverty, and very uncomfortable.
For men accustomed to eating seven-course dinners and sleeping between fine linen sheets at home, the change to the Alps must have been very hard indeed.

inlineAnnotations.label: accustomed to eating seven-course dinners and sleeping between fine linen sheets at home

expansionNotes.label: it is hard for sb. to do sth. sb.很难去做某事

examples.enExample: It is hard for me to believe that he did this.
It is hard for students to concentrate during long lectures.
It is hard for animals to survive in extreme weather conditions.

expansionNotes.label: except for / but for 除了 / 若没有...

examples.enExample: Except for your help, I couldn’t have finished the project.
examples.zhExample: 若没有你的帮助，我无法完成这个项目

examples.enExample: But for the rain, we would have gone hiking.
examples.zhExample: 若不是下雨，我们就去远足了

examples.enExample: I would buy a Mercedes except / but (that) I am poor.
examples.zhExample: 真实（接宾语从句后面的for要去掉）

examples.enExample: I would buy a Mercedes if I were rich.

examples.zhExample: 若没有她的建议，我就迷路了。

examples.enExample: Except for / But for / If it were not for your support, I would be in big trouble now.
